title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro 256GB Burgundy $2,049 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Umart (Price Beat $1,946.55 @ Officeworks)
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 18 Pro 256GB Burgundy $2,049 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Umart (Price Beat $1,946.55 @ Officeworks)

[AutomationGuy] If you want to share that as a deal, you have to post the Umart deal as a bargain, and put your PB and gift cards in the comments.
[alexae86] I guess rules are rules 🤷‍♂️ Shame it makes it harder for people to see the full deal and the different ways they can save, but what can you do
[werdplaya58] Yeah pretty sure price beat does not in itself constitute a "deal", and Officeworks specifically don't price match stores with a menbership requirement.
[CBrads4] They do price match stores with memberships, they changed their T&Cs a few months ago to accept matching from retailers like Costco.
[alexae86] Officeworks Price Beat + Aldi Gift Card Stacking
Officeworks iPhone listing: https://www.officeworks.com.au/shop/officeworks/p/iphone-18-…
I managed to get Officeworks to beat Umart's price by 5%.
Price breakdown:
Umart price: $2,049.00
Officeworks 5% Price Beat: -$102.45
Officeworks price: $1,946.55
I also used 30 Aldi Celebrate gift cards from the previous 10% off gift card deal:
Gift card value used: $1,500
Actual cost of gift cards: $1,350
Remaining balance paid by card: $446.55
My effective final price: $1,796.55
That's an additional $150 saving from the gift cards.
A tip for getting the price beat:
I called my local Officeworks store before going in to confirm they would beat Umart's price. They confirmed Umart was acceptable, so I went in and completed the purchase using my gift cards.
I've found Costco can be difficult, especially when the item isn't currently in stock, while SkyTree was a straight no. Umart was accepted in my case.
Price beat approval is subject to Officeworks' terms and conditions.
[hawkeye93] Costco is widely accepted now, they changed the rule couple months ago. However, it's YMMV whether they ask for proof of Costco membership (some stores do, some don't).
[jmel] if you use onepass, you will get around $50 worth of points too. Also if they dont beat umart, they can absolutely beat MSY which is an official apple retailer
[ZJack] Feel a bit disappointed in my bad decision before 18 pro release. I price beat two 17 Pro 512gb at OfficeWorks for around $1950, I wanted the larger storage for the sake of keeping each of our whole iCloud Photo libraries on local storage. Then I waited to collect it until I saw the 18 Pro release and was still happy with the decision.
Now that I’ve set up the phones and connected a shared photo library for the first time, this has exceeded capacity of the 512GB phones and it’s back to storing just a few GB of local files. May as well have got 256GB phones for less, or waited two months and got this phone for the same price.
